In the diff, the only test-related change is a Playwright e2e expectation update (`destinationCalendar: null` -> `[]`), and no unit/integration tests are added/modified to exercise these new EventManager behaviors. While the claim that *no* EventManager tests exist at all cannot be proven from this diff alone, it is fair and specific to note that this PR introduces nontrivial behavioral changes without adding targeted automated regression coverage in the changeset.
